race.comment: GEETEE FORTY (14) hasn't won for a long time but is going better than his form reads and has a good turn of foot on his day. Gets a nice drop in grade and will be launching late. FANTASTIC HOST (6) often leaves himself with too much to do but put it all together last start when scoring stylishly at Murray Bridge. Already boasts a win over this track and trip and can make it two on the bounce if he holds his form. BELLE FROM HELL (5) continues to flash home and savage the line. If Hutchinson can settle that pair or two closer this time she can get the job done. HAMNER SPRINGS (8) was back to his best last start when leading all the way here. Have to include.
